description: This file defines the ContactsListActivity class, an Android FragmentActivity that manages the display of a contacts list and contact details, handling search queries and different screen layouts.

classes.name: ContactsListActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the contacts list UI, handling search intents, and fragment interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, handles search intent, and manages fragments based on device layout.

methods.name: onContactSelected
methods.description: Callback for when a contact is selected; updates detail fragment or starts detail activity.

methods.name: onSelectionCleared
methods.description: Callback for when contact selection is cleared; resets detail fragment.

methods.name: onSearchRequested
methods.description: Controls whether a new search can be initiated, preventing multiple search overlays.
